findings.message: The default launch speed is 4 m/s. The layout text says the default scrubber reads 0 to 0.816327 s, and that matches 2·4/9.8. I found no inconsistency. The callout text is not shown in the frames, only its boxes and the readouts. The wording 'Moving up', 'Still for an instant' and 'Moving down' therefore comes from the readout only. I cannot judge the 'Gravity pulls down' line from the frames.
